title: アカデミックリーディング2
subtitle: Academic Reading 2
courseType:
English Language Program
English Language Courses
educationalGoal: There are 3 course objectives 1. Be able to read and understand passages in the textbook at an appropriate speed. 2. Be able to understand, read, pronounce the vocabulary in the textbook. 3. Acquire the habit of watching TED talk videos to learn about current topics.
advice: Reading is a core component of listening, speaking, and writing skills. The objective of this course is to improve all 4 skills through reading passages at an appropriate speed to understand the content. The following topics will be covered: Unit 9: Who We Are. Unit 10: Global Warming. Unit 11: Incredible Insects. Unit 12: Going to Extremes. Extra readings will be distributed in class. Active learning in English class includes presentations, Q&A sessions, pair-work, group work, and worksheets. Preview: Read the story, check the content, pronunciation, vocabulary, and answer all of the questions in the textbook. In class: Ask questions and solve any problems you have encountered during the preview. Review: Check the content and pronunciation of the words in the story and memorize the vocabulary. Use office hours to ask extra questions. Make extensive reading a habit. (Make a habit of reading one or two books a week). Make study plans throughout the semester.
requiredKnowledge: Students must have a basic knowledge of grammar and vocabulary. There will be daily quizzes. Quizzes will be collected after students check the answers and scores, so each student must keep a record of their progress.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the topic of the story in each unit.
Be able to understand the structure of paragraphs and stories.
Be able to read, listen, pronounce, and write the words in the story in each unit.
Be able to find specific infomation about each story using various reading skills at an appropriate speed.
Be able to understand the story and exchange opinions with other students.
Have the habit of watching TED talk videos to learn about current topics.
